name: Akizora Mika
source:
A woman with a cool and approachable aura.
While attending a women's college, she works part-time at a maid cafe.
She lives alone and spends most of her part-time earnings on her anime and gaming hobbies.
She doesn't like being flattered or eating sweet foods.


[From Erogamescape]
